Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the time on today's demo — appreciate the thoughtful questions from your Security and Platform teams. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum:

- Ask 1: SOC 2 status — if you can confirm current attestation (Type I/II) and any timelines for obtaining Type II, that helps us map to SLA options.
- Ask 2: Subprocessor inventory — a simple CSV with provider name, role (hosting, monitoring, analytics), and data types shared is ideal. This will help us quickly check boundaries for PHI/PII.
- Ask 3: Regulatory constraints — you mentioned HIPAA in the call; can you confirm whether PHI will be sent to Redwood in production or only redacted inputs for the PoC?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (short summary of our SOC 2 controls and what customers typically ask for).

Proposed next steps:
1) Please share your subprocessor CSV and any existing attestation docs.
2) We'll kick off the security questionnaire (link in my next email) and share a draft DPA.
3) Marissa from our Security team will map technical follow-ups about caching/retention.

Would you be able to share the roster and an attestation by EOD Wednesday (3/17)? If not, let us know a realistic ETA.

Best,

Heads up — got Samir's note and CSV.

Couple of technical clarifications we should ask next:
- KV cache / prefix caching: confirm whether Blue Horizon expects us to retain request-specific KV state beyond the session. If they plan to store transcripts with PHI later, we'll need a retention policy and optional TTL controls.
- Streaming logs / debug traces: they may want assurance we can restrict PII in logs and provide an option to disable verbose traces for their production workload.
- Hosting: since they flagged on-prem as a possibility for PHI, can you confirm whether the initial PoC requires on-prem (likely not) or if a Private (VPC) deployment with customer-controlled keys would be acceptable?

I've uploaded the CSV and my notes to the deal folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example
